name: Pallet

size.label: Size
size.desc: Footprint, from the six of ISO 6780; every size is 135 mm tall. The built-in AGV's forks enter the long face of every size, and the short face of the three square sizes too, above the bottom runners.

mass.label: Mass (kg)
mass.desc: Physical mass of the pallet itself, before anything is stacked on it.

color.label: Color
color.desc: Tint over the pallet wood texture. White leaves it untinted.
